# SQLite 3.53.4

This directory contains the official SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation, version
`3530400`, downloaded from the SQLite download page:

https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip

The source archive and vendored C source were verified with SHA3-256:

```text
archive: 628a44cfe82c66aed1ccbbe85a562d2e33ebe64b3288981ed76285612227934e
sqlite3.c: 67f423e9ebbbdc473cbc4772c872ee6b89f31fde4ed0279a5c25d5f65c043a16
```

SQLite is public-domain software. The build uses the pinned source with the
roadmap-required configuration options and does not link against a system
SQLite library.
